selection: Existing evaluate.py chooser on each six-session-purged WalkForward training fold; same original candidates and episode decisions. No reserved-segment selection.
portfolio_semantics: Replay selected exposure targets, with net rebalancing when consecutive episodes coincide. This is a portfolio replay, not the independent reset-to-cash raw-price episode arithmetic.
timing: Weights and integer sizing frozen at completed decision-day close; native MarketOnOpenOrder uses a later session's bundled daily open. No opening-auction quality acceptance.
normalization: Raw; native factor-file distributions credit cash separately, without double-counting adjusted prices.
pass: Native completed status, no runtime error or failed data request, every fill bound to an intent at a strictly earlier UTC time, all positions flat, cash = initial - signed fill notional - native fees + native distributions within one cent.
